topic.source_contract: lighting need, layout, photometry, timing, receptors, dark-sky and ecological effects, planning conditions, installation, commissioning and monitored performance evidence

scope_guards: A lighting concept is not treated as a verified photometric design.
Manufacturer data is not treated as installed-site performance.
A planning condition is not treated as discharged.
A bat survey is not treated as an approved lighting mitigation scheme.
A dark-sky designation is not treated as an automatic planning refusal.
Installed luminaires are not treated as correctly aimed or commissioned.
A complaint-free period is not treated as measured compliance.
No score or promotion is written without exact design, consent, installation, commissioning and monitored receptor evidence.

Current control settings and failures required
